title: Good average ROAS, poor marginal ROAS; a power-law fit is the wrong curve
plant_ref: config channels.applovin: Hill response (h=1.6, k_over_base=0.8) plus quality_gamma=0.6 (incremental players worth less)

expected.notes: Average ROAS is good so decreasing is wrong. A fitted power law may overstate marginal ROAS, so an increase_test is tolerable only as a pre-registered bounded test; a permanent increase is wrong.
